A Listen, read and circle.
Circle the games that you hear.
dragon dance hopscotch Chinese yo-yo sandbags tug of war kite-flying
Chinese chess lion dance skipping rope

Fun time
Welcome to our garden party!
Here comes our garden party on 26 September.
There will be all kinds of interesting traditional games on the sports field: Chinese yo-yo playing, kite-flying, dragon dance, tug of war, hopscotch and many others. After playing each game, you can stamp your card and get a prize.
Come and have a go!
Let’s have fun together.
Sound ar garden
The game card says, “Find a star, a toy car and a bar of chocolate in the garden.
It’s not very hard.”
B Match and tell.
Match the name with the picture and say which game(s) you want to play.
tug of war kite-flying hopscotch Chinese yo-yo a b c d
I want to play tug of war.
I can say the names of some traditional games.

Talking time
As fast as the wind
A Watch the video.
James Mr Zhong Shenshen Xiaojiang
Mr Zhong, is this Shaolin kung fu?
This is changquan — Long Fist.
It’s the mother of many kung fu styles.
Oh, I see. Many kung fu styles come from Long Fist?
That’s right!
It’s amazing!
There are twelve kinds of actions.
Look, what does this look like?
A tree?
Correct. Stand like a pine tree.
Very strong and proud.
Look at us. Three straight trees!
Excellent! Let me show you another one. What does this look like?
I know! Sit like a bell.
Clever girl! How about this?
Wow, you move so fast!
As fast as the wind. I use all my strength for every action. That’s why it’s so fast!

Unit 2
B Read and complete the notes.
Changquan (Long Fist)
12 kinds of 1 others stand like a 2 move as fast as the 4 sit like a 3
C Show and tell your classmates some kung fu actions.
Look at me. I look like a ...
...
Look at me. I move/ stand/sit ... I ...
Find the rule
Look at us.
Stand like a pine tree.
Come and have a go.
I can talk about how to do changquan (Long Fist).
I can describe the different actions according to the pictures.

Story time
The dragon dance
The students in the dragon dance team are training hard for the coming garden party.
As the head of the dragon, Minmin runs very fast.
“Head of the dragon, slow down! We can’t keep up with you!” Xiaopu calls out at the tail of the dragon.
The background music is loud.
Minmin can’t hear Xiaopu. He runs even faster.
The players at the tail of the dragon lose control of the sticks.
A Read and write.

3 control of the sticks.
Today we are training hard. I am the head of the dragon. Then
At first Mr Zhong gives us a tip. To play well, the dragon’s head, body and
The head of the dragon: I run tail need to be 4 .
1 .
At last
The body of the dragon: The players can’t 2 with me. We keep the 5 and the dragon dance is a great success!

Unit 2
“Stop!” Mr Zhong calls out.
“To play well, all the students at the dragon’s head, body and tail need to be in step.
Minmin, listen to the music and follow it. Everyone, follow
Minmin. Let’s try again.”
Mr Zhong says.
This time, all the players keep the same pace and the long dragon comes to life.
Quick tip fast (adv.) — faster
B Discuss the questions with your partner.
What is the key to the success of the dragon dance?
What other games follow the same rule?
...
...
I can explain the rules of dragon dance.

Project
A presentation of my favourite traditional game
A View and learn.
Kite-flying is my favourite traditional game.
I need a kite and a roll of thread. On days with nice wind, I can run fast and fly the kite into the sky. I like it because it is very exciting. I like it more than other games.
Come and have a try!
B Introduce your favourite game.
Step1 Choose a game and tell your partner.
What is your favourite traditional game?
?
Step2 Tell other students what you need to play and how to play.
I need ...
I can ... I need a kite.
... ...
Step3 Explain why you like it.
I like it because it is very interesting.
Come and have a go!
I can introduce my favourite traditional game to my classmates.
